g.text: Rolling Out New Code Without Dropping a Request
One batch of a rolling deploy: 2 instances draining out, 2 instances health-checking in
One batch = 5% of a 4,000-instance fleet = 200 instances at a time, ~20 batches total.
Capacity floor: never more than one batch's worth (5%) missing from rotation at once -
an invariant the orchestrator enforces, not a best-effort target.
LONG-LIVED CONNECTION PATH (WebSocket) - a different drain, not a hard disconnect
